steps.body: Ninety-seven, ninety-eight, ninety-nine… one hundred! The count reaches 100.
steps.narration: Ninety-seven, ninety-eight, ninety-nine… one hundred! The count reaches 100.

widget.prompt: Start at 95 and count on 5. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That's 3 hops. Count 5 from 95 to land on 100.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 95 and count on 5: you land on 100.
widget.successFeedback: 95 and 5 more is 100 — you reached one hundred!

predict.prompt: Counting on 5 from 95 — will you pass 100?
predict.reveal: 95 count on 5 reaches 100 exactly. Landing ON 100 is not passing it — you would need one more count to go past.
